Text: And now for my combo move and what I recommend for anyone who wants to really see some real efficiencies using Grok Build for long running tasks.

Use workflows and goals together. Here's an example of how to do this:

1. I put together a workflow to triage a bunch of issues

2. then I take the report it puts together, with the prioritization list, and pick say the top 10 highest priority issues to tackle

3. Give those prioritized findings to /goal and let it tackle them, continuing until it's done
